what.text: This page follows refugees from Togo in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12661 refugees from Togo.
Benin hosts the largest share, 37.3%, followed by Ghana, France and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Togo with the MTD in 1986 and with JNIM from 2022 to 2025.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in the main years of displacement, so it does not say why people left then.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1985 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 291055, at the end of 1993, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1993 and 1994.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
